passages.text: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
passages.sermon: Jesus came down from the mountain.\r\nMany people followed Jesus.\r\nThese people formed large crowds.
passages.original: Καταβάντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί

passages.text: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
passages.sermon:
A man had leprosy.
He came to Jesus.
He knelt before Jesus.
He spoke to Jesus.
He said, “Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean.”
passages.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρὸς προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων Κύριε ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι

passages.text: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
passages.sermon:
Jesus saw the man with leprosy.
Jesus reached out His hand.
Jesus touched the man.
Jesus said, “I am willing.”
Jesus said, “Be clean!”
The man’s leprosy was immediately cleansed.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο αὐτοῦ λέγων Θέλω καθαρίσθητι καὶ εὐθέως ἐκαθαρίσθη αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα

passages.text: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the man He had healed.
Jesus gave him instructions.
Jesus said, “Do not tell anyone.”
Jesus said, “Go to the priest.”
Jesus said, “Show yourself to the priest.”
Jesus said, “Offer the gift Moses commanded.”
Jesus said, “This will be a testimony to them.”
passages.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὅρα μηδενὶ εἴπῃς ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκον τὸ δῶρον ὃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς

passages.text: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him, “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus entered Capernaum.
A centurion approached Jesus.
The centurion pleaded with Jesus.
He said, “Lord, my servant is at home.
My servant is paralyzed.
My servant suffers greatly.”
passages.original: Εἰσελθόντος δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ ἑκατόνταρχος παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγων Κύριε ὁ παῖς μου βέβληται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ παραλυτικός δεινῶς βασανιζόμενος

passages.text: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to the centurion.\r\nJesus said, “I will go.\r\nI will heal your servant.”
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν θεραπεύσω αὐτόν

passages.text: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
passages.sermon:
A centurion spoke to Jesus.
The centurion was a Roman officer.
He said, “Lord, I am not worthy for You to enter my house.”
He said, “Only speak the word.”
He said, “My servant will be healed.”
passages.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος ἔφη Κύριε οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς ἵνα μου ὑπὸ τὴν στέγην εἰσέλθῃς ἀλλὰ μόνον εἰπὲ λόγῳ καὶ ἰαθήσεται ὁ παῖς μου

passages.text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
passages.sermon:
The centurion spoke to Jesus.
The centurion was a Roman officer.
He had authority over soldiers.
He was also under the authority of others.
He said, “I am a man under authority.
I have soldiers under me.
I tell one soldier, ‘Go.’
He goes.
I tell another soldier, ‘Come.’
He comes.
I tell my servant, ‘Do this.’
He does it.”
passages.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπός εἰμι ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν ἔχων ὑπ’ ἐμαυτὸν στρατιώτας καὶ λέγω τούτῳ Πορεύθητι καὶ πορεύεται καὶ ἄλλῳ Ἔρχου καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ τῷ δούλῳ μου Ποίησον τοῦτο καὶ ποιεῖ

passages.text: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
passages.sermon:
Jesus heard the centurion’s words.
Jesus marveled at the centurion.
Jesus spoke to the people who followed Him.
Jesus said, “Truly, I tell you.
I have not found such great faith in anyone in Israel.”
passages.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐθαύμασεν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀκολουθοῦσιν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν παρ’ οὐδενὶ τοσαύτην πίστιν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εὗρον

passages.text: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people following Him.
Jesus said, “Many people will come from the east.
Many people will come from the west.
These people will join Abraham in the kingdom of heaven.
They will join Isaac in the kingdom of heaven.
They will join Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
They will share the banquet together.”
passages.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν ἥξουσιν καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν

passages.text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke about the sons of the kingdom.
The sons of the kingdom are the people who belong to Israel.
They will be thrown into the outer darkness.
In that place, there will be weeping.
There will also be gnashing of teeth.
passages.original: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας ἐκβληθήσονται εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων

passages.text: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the centurion.
Jesus said, "Go."
Jesus said, "It will be done for you as you have believed."
The centurion's servant was healed at that very hour.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ Ὕπαγε ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι καὶ ἰάθη ὁ παῖς αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

passages.text: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
passages.sermon:
Jesus arrived at Peter’s house.
Peter had a mother-in-law.
Peter’s mother-in-law was in bed.
She was sick.
She had a fever.
Jesus saw her.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Πέτρου εἶδεν τὴν πενθερὰν αὐτοῦ βεβλημένην καὶ πυρέσσουσαν

passages.text: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
Jesus touched her hand.
The fever left her.
She got up.
She began to serve Jesus and those with Him.
passages.original: καὶ ἥψατο τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ διηκόνει αὐτῷ

passages.text: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus has authority over evil spirits and sickness.
Evening arrived.
People brought many demon-possessed individuals to Jesus.
Jesus spoke a word.
He drove out the evil spirits.
Jesus healed all the sick people.
passages.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δαιμονιζομένους πολλούς καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ πνεύματα λόγῳ καὶ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ἐθεράπευσεν

passages.text: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus fulfilled the words spoken by the prophet Isaiah.
Isaiah said these words about Jesus.
Jesus took on our infirmities.
Jesus carried our diseases.
passages.original: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Αὐτὸς τὰς ἀσθενείας ἡμῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ τὰς νόσους ἐβάστασεν

passages.text: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
passages.sermon: Jesus saw a large crowd around Him.\r\nHe gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
passages.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς πολλοὺς ὄχλον περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκέλευσεν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν

passages.text: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
passages.sermon: A scribe came to Jesus.\r\nThe scribe spoke to Jesus.\r\nHe said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
passages.original: Καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς γραμματεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ

passages.text: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the scribe.
Jesus called Himself the Son of Man.
Foxes have dens.
Birds of the air have nests.
The Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις ὁ δὲ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ

passages.text: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
passages.sermon:
One of Jesus’ disciples spoke to Him.
This disciple made a request.
He said, “Lord, let me go first.”
He wanted to bury his father before following Jesus.
passages.original: Ἕτερος δὲ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθεῖν καὶ θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου

passages.text: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the disciple.
Jesus said, "Follow Me."
Jesus said, "Let the dead bury their own dead."
Jesus told the disciple to come with Him immediately.
Jesus told the disciple not to delay for family duties.
Jesus called the disciple to put following Him first.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι καὶ ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς

passages.text: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
passages.sermon: Jesus got into the boat.\r\nHis disciples followed Him.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐμβάντι αὐτῷ εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
passages.sermon:
A violent storm appeared suddenly on the sea.
The storm was very strong.
Waves covered the boat.
Jesus was in the boat.
Jesus was sleeping.
passages.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον καλύπτεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκάθευδεν

passages.text: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus was sleeping in the boat.
A violent storm engulfed the boat with waves.
The disciples followed Jesus.
The disciples went to Jesus.
They woke Him up.
They said, “Lord, save us!”
They said, “We are perishing!”
passages.original: καὶ προσελθόντες ἤγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε σῶσον ἀπολλύμεθα

passages.text: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was in the boat with His disciples during a violent storm.
The boat was being engulfed by waves.
Jesus was sleeping.
The disciples woke Jesus.
Jesus spoke to His disciples.
Jesus said, "You have little faith."
Jesus asked, "Why are you so afraid?"
Jesus got up.
Jesus rebuked the winds.
Jesus rebuked the sea.
The winds and the sea became perfectly calm.
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί δειλοί ἐστε ὀλιγόπιστοι τότε ἐγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς ἀνέμοις καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη

passages.text: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
passages.sermon:
The men saw what Jesus did.
They were amazed.
They spoke to each other.
They asked, "What kind of man is this?"
They saw that even the winds obey Jesus.
They saw that the sea obeys Him too.
passages.original: Οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες Ποταπός ἐστιν οὗτος ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ ἡ θάλασσα αὐτῷ ὑπακούουσιν

passages.text: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
passages.sermon:
Jesus arrived in the region of the Gadarenes.
Two men met Jesus.
These men were possessed by demons.
They came out from the tombs.
These men were extremely violent.
No one could pass along that road because of them.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πέραν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γαδαρηνῶν ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ δύο δαιμονιζόμενοι ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἐξερχόμενοι χαλεποὶ λίαν ὥστε μὴ ἰσχύειν τινὰ παρελθεῖν διὰ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐκείνης

passages.text: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
passages.sermon:
Two demon-possessed men met Jesus.
They shouted at Jesus.
They said, “What do you want with us, Son of God?”
They asked Jesus, “Have you come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
passages.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔκραξαν λέγοντες Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἦλθες ὧδε πρὸ καιροῦ βασανίσαι ἡμᾶς

passages.text: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
passages.sermon: A large herd of pigs was feeding.\r\nThe herd was far away from Jesus and the demon-possessed men.\r\nThe pigs were together in the distance.
passages.original: Ἦν δὲ μακρὰν ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἀγέλη χοίρων πολλῶν βοσκομένη

passages.text: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
passages.sermon: The demons spoke to Jesus.\r\nThe demons begged Jesus.\r\nThe demons said, “If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
passages.original: οἱ δὲ δαίμονες παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Εἰ ἐκβάλλεις ἡμᾶς ἀπόστειλον ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀγέλην τῶν χοίρων

passages.text: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the demons.
He said, "Go!"
The demons left the men.
The demons entered the pigs.
The whole herd of pigs ran down the steep bank.
The pigs rushed into the sea.
All the pigs died in the water.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἀπῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους καὶ ἰδοὺ ὥρμησεν πᾶσα ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἀπέθανον ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν

passages.text: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
passages.sermon:
Some men were tending the pigs.
These men saw what happened.
They ran away.
They went into the town.
They told everything that had happened.
They also told about the demon-possessed men.
passages.original: Οἱ δὲ βόσκοντες ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα καὶ τὰ τῶν δαιμονιζομένων

passages.text: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
passages.sermon:
The whole town heard what happened.
The people in the town went out to meet Jesus.
They saw Jesus.
They begged Jesus to leave their region.
passages.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ πόλις ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ὑπάντησιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν παρεκάλεσαν ὅπως μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν
